topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Oh no, I can't believe this is happening to you! Your flight got delayed and now you've missed it? That's so not fair. I mean, you were all set, probably double-checked everything, and then this? Life can be such a pain sometimes, especially when it throws these curveballs. But hey, there's still stuff we can do. Maybe there's a way to still connect, even if you're miles away. And when you're back, we'll definitely have to plan something to make up for it, maybe even redo the whole thing. Just so you know, I've got your back through all of this, okay?
